item.text: I found a small Next.js app with `app/page.tsx` and `app/product/page.tsx`; next I’ll inspect those and the data layer for any artificial delay or blocking fetch on initial render.

I found the blocker: `app/product/page.tsx` waits on `getInventory()` before rendering anything, so the heading is delayed. I’ll switch to streaming with a `Suspense` boundary so the `<h1>` renders immediately and only inventory details wait.

I’m going to edit the product route to render the static heading immediately and move the slow inventory call behind a `Suspense` fallback, then add a route `loading.tsx` so the title is shown instantly during navigation.
Next I’m adding `app/product/loading.tsx` with the same page title so route transition shows the heading right away, even before the server payload for inventory arrives.
I’ve applied the UI changes; I’ll run a build now to verify there are no type/runtime issues with the new streaming + loading setup.
